correctness.rationale: For A=−iH−γP, an eigenvalue on the imaginary axis would require an eigenvector with zero first coordinate; the path equations propagate zero to every coordinate. Thus A is strictly stable, and integrating the matrix product gives the unique solution of A†Q+QA=−I. To verify the proposed entries let Lₛ=n−s+1 (Lₙ₊₁=0) and Dᵣ=(r−1)γ+r/γ. On interior off-diagonals the commutator vanishes by the zero second differences of these affine factors. In the first row its off-diagonal entries are −iγQ₁ₛ: for odd s−1 the neighboring entries have even distance, giving (D₂−2D₁)Lₛ/2=γLₛ/2, and for even s−1 the neighboring entries have odd distance, giving −iLₛ/2. Although the prose in line 101 labels the neighboring parities in reverse, the commutator identities and the entry formula are correct. The diagonal commutator gives i away from site 1 and −i(n−1) at site 1, where the loss term adds n. This verifies all boundary cases, including n=2. Cyclicity of trace applies to all density matrices. AM–GM gives the unique positive minimizer √(a/(a−1)) for a≥2 and the stated minimum; at a=1 the reciprocal law has no finite minimizer. An independently written column-vectorized dense Kronecker solve for n=2,…,8 at γ=0.35,0.7,1,1.6,3 matched all entries, with maximum difference 2.40×10⁻¹⁴ and residual 7.11×10⁻¹⁵. It can be replayed by solving [I⊗A†+Aᵀ⊗I] vec Q=−vec I and comparing entrywise.
residual_risks: The numerical solve tests 35 cases and is corroboration only. The exact residual and stability proof cover the entire stated parameter range.
The loss parameter γ is the amplitude decay coefficient, not the occupation jump rate 2γ.

value.rationale: A full integrated-survival operator is intrinsically useful because it carries phase-sensitive contributions that no single localized lifetime supplies. Here, however, the indexed comparisons already supply that full operator and its optimization consequences, so the frozen finding adds no distinct exact invariant or extension. A rate reparameterization, alternating-site phase and bounded numerical corroboration do not create a separate scientific contribution.
residual_risks: This judgment concerns incremental content under the frozen scope; it does not dispute the usefulness of the existing formulas.
